Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 3 
months as indicated by M3 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Aassy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad

 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of
